parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  inputs: [
    {
      id: $json.lead.email,
      idProperty: 'email',
      properties: {
        email: $json.lead.email,
        firstname: $json.lead.firstName,
        lastname: $json.lead.lastName,
        ...( $json.lead.phone ? { phone: $json.lead.phone } : {} ),
        company: $json.lead.company,
        jobtitle: $json.lead.jobTitle,
        ...( $json.lead.website ? { website: $json.lead.website } : {} ),
        hubspot_owner_id: '99398461',
        lifecyclestage: 'lead',
        hs_lead_status: 'NEW',
        lead_score: String($json.leadScore ?? 0),
        lead_tier: $json.leadTier || 'COLD',
        buying_intent: $json.qualification?.buying_intent || 'Unknown',
        icp_fit: $json.qualification?.ideal_customer_fit || 'Unknown',
        budget_level: $json.qualification?.budget_level || 'Unknown',
        authority_level: $json.qualification?.authority_level || 'Unknown',
        pain_points: Array.isArray($json.mappedPainPoints)
          ? $json.mappedPainPoints.join('; ')
          : Array.isArray($json.qualification?.pain_points)
            ? $json.qualification.pain_points.join('; ')
            : '',
        ai_qualification_summary: $json.qualification?.qualification_summary || ''
      }
    }
  ]
} }}
